title: a callback passed into foreign code is rejected until an owned adapter defines its invocation and lifetime
notes: poc/src/language/README.md: 'Any callback passed into foreign code is rejected until a Smithers-owned Result/task adapter defines its invocation and lifetime.' The underlying locked rule is specification/requirements.mdx, 'Scoping': 'Imported JavaScript or TypeScript that starts hidden background work owns that work. Caller-controlled background APIs MUST expose explicit completion or disposal handles through their adapters.' A callback handed to foreign code has no checked invocation count, no checked lifetime, and no checked failure channel, so it fails closed.
